<div class="card-body">
'''Admiral Motti''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].







<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">モッティ提督</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">場に帝国軍の宇宙船が２隻以上出ていれば、配備コスト－２となる。モッティと同じ星系にいる反乱軍パイロットは、没収値－１となる。モッティが操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力＋２になる。</span>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">デス・スターの指揮を任されている帝国宇宙軍司令官。科学技術を過信し、フォースを蔑視する。野心的な帝国軍のリーダー。皇帝の勅命を支持して昇進したが、軍事能力は評価されていない。ベイダーを嫌っている。</span>''
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Admiral Motti.

'''Card text:''' If at least two Imperial starships are on the table, deploy cost is −2. Rebel pilots in the same system as Motti have forfeit −1. A starship Motti pilots has power +2.

'''Lore:''' An Imperial Navy commander entrusted with command of the Death Star. He puts excessive faith in technology and despises the Force. An ambitious Imperial leader. He was promoted for supporting the Emperor's decree, but his military ability is not highly regarded. He dislikes Vader.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore says Motti supported the Emperor's decree, while the English printed lore says he supported the New Order. The Japanese says his military ability is not highly regarded; the English says he was promoted because of his support rather than his military skills.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Admiral Motti]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="psa">[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/star-wars-ccg-japanese-premiere/imagegallery/29544 Japanese Premiere collector image gallery], PSA.</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97.
